4875-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4875-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3384-4067-6827-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-6827-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
1169-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4053-5499-6965--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6965--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

64-1987-3227-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-3227-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Warden of the Eye.
When Scrivener and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-3227-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2173-3661-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-6844.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-6844.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Spider-Man 2099 and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Spider-Man 2099 and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-6844.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-6797-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-6797-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

225-5702--131.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
225-5702--131.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5702--131.description:
Animate the land.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

225-1671-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-1671-4572-5702.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2034-3330-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3330-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3719-6188-6307-6798--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-6188-6307-6798--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1069-3228-5499-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-5499-6791.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2018-3195-4053.description:
Activate Dromar's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
When Dromar's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Dromar's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-4785.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

1808-2511-3000.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

765-1479-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-3534.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2440-5090-5917.easyPrerequisites: Singing Bell Strike attached to The Jolly Balloon Man.
2440-5090-5917.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
You control at least six creatures that are either Balloons or that share a creature type with the nonlegendary creature.
2440-5090-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

2719-4929-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
2719-4929-5365.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Clue ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

141-1409-2528.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Naru Meha.
141-1409-2528.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2686-4274-5049.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Barren Glory by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Resolve Barren Glory.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

1869-2232-3821-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Conspiracy.
1869-2232-3821-4875.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

1456-2146-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

413-1981-4378.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, choosing any target.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and gaining 1 life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier token.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat.

618-864-957.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness with haste.
The token copy of Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1322-2034-4289-4499-5251.description:
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord for {1}.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap the token creature for {1}.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Emiel the blessed to exile Emmara, Soul of the Accord then return her to the battlefield untapped.
Repeat.

721-1363-2724.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Tradewind Rider does not have summoning sickness.
721-1363-2724.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Wormfang Manta, and one other creature, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
